install: git clone https://github.com/omerdikyol/squid5060ti.git && cd squid5060ti && git checkout 5945ebb53aedde8a77bec657509a9a51a35fa470 && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast (Linux x86_64 or WSL2, CUDA 13.1+ nvcc/cublas, Zig 0.17.1+, Blackwell sm_120a GPU; add -Dccbin=g++-14 on Ubuntu 26.04)
setup: Not Docker; native Linux x86_64 or Windows 11 + WSL2 Ubuntu binary (zero Python at runtime). Requires NVIDIA Blackwell GPU (sm_120a, >=16 GB VRAM: RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB, RTX 5070 Ti, RTX 5080, RTX 5090), driver 580+, CUDA Toolkit 13.1+, and Zig 0.17.1+. Host-pins ~1.0 GiB (embed + markov_w1) + ~950 MiB prefix cache checkpoints in system RAM.
